thread:
sophia (People Ops): Heads up — time to collect nominations for our March "Thanks & Kudos" spot awards. We have 10 x $100 gift cards + 5 swag bundles. Please drop nominations by EOD Thurs.
sophia (People Ops): Quick notes: we need manager approvals for any award > $100, and finance needs final list by next Friday 03/03 for payroll processing. Link to nomination form: <https://forms.gle/nominate-redwood> :sparkles:
tara (People Ops): tagging hiring managers — can we also highlight any cross-team hires who went above & beyond? those often get missed. @julia (Hiring Ops) can you forward any standout interview/offer work?
julia (Hiring Ops): got it — I'll pull notes from the last two hiring sprints and post a short list tomorrow. also happy to coordinate approvals for candidate success recognitions.
miguel (Eng): quick Q — can ICs nominate peers or does it have to go through managers? would prefer peers nominate for shoutouts.
sophia (People Ops): peers absolutely can nominate. We ask managers to confirm before we finalize payouts — just to confirm role/tenure and no conflicts. Peer nominations are encouraged!
kevin (Finance): FYI on payroll: gift cards processed as taxable benefits in our system. For the $100 awards we need employee legal names + preferred payout method by 03/03. If anyone wants non-monetary swag only, mark that on the form.
miguel (Eng): noted. I'll send a short team thread asking folks to nominate by Weds. Any preference for voting? emoji reactions or a quick private poll?
sophia (People Ops): emoji reactions are fine for lightweight voting, but final decisions should be by managers + people ops. We'll use reaction tallies as signal only. We'll ask managers to confirm winners via the sheet.
recognition-bot: Reminder scheduled — nomination form closes in 72 hours. :bell:
anna (CEO): Awesome — love seeing this. If possible, can we surface 1-2 micro-stories in the monthly all-hands (2 min each)? puts faces to the awards.
tara (People Ops): yes please — if managers can add a 1-2 sentence anecdote in the approval column that helps with all-hands storytelling. I'll assemble highlights for the 03/08 all-hands.
kevin (Finance): one more logistical ask: if someone leaves before payout, we need a note from the manager to reallocate budget. Low chance but we need the policy followed.
sophia (People Ops): thanks everyone. TL;DR: nominate via form by EOD Thurs, managers confirm, finance needs final list by 03/03. I'll post a follow-up with the Google Sheet export and a checklist for managers. :raised_hands:
sophia (People Ops): ps — if anyone wants to request a physical swag item instead of a gift card (hoodie, water bottle), choose "swag" on the form and note sizes/address. we ship globally but add 2 weeks lead time.
julia (Hiring Ops): posted shortlist for cross-team hiring support nominees in the #hiring-ops channel. cc @sophia
miguel (Eng): thanks, on it. :thumbsup:
